correctness.rationale: For the homogeneous continuous-time absorbing SIS chain on path P3 with per-vertex recovery 1 and per-edge infection lambda>0, all seven transient states communicate, giving unique positive left-Perron quasi-stationary vector. Endpoint symmetry reduces to five probabilities a,b,c,d,e satisfying 5x5 balance matrix M. Its determinant, adjugate cofactors and two resultants establish a>b>c before lambda=3/4, c>b>a afterward; at 3/4 five labelled configurations tie at 1/6 while d=1/24,e=1/8, and extinction rate is 1/2. A third eliminant F(lambda)=18lambda^5-140lambda^4+77lambda^3+92lambda^2-50lambda+4, Sturm variation counts and Perron range bounds show the only admissible pair/full crossing lambda*=1.0092470826...; d<c globally. Independently evaluated full seven-state QSD at rates on both sides and inspected source exact SymPy verification.py. The theorem concerns asymptotic conditional modes, not finite-time epidemic modes.
